references.text: Ekron is mentioned here as one of the Philistine cities assigned to the tribe of Judah, and the boundary extended to the territory of Ekron
Ekron is mentioned as a city in the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, near the border area described in Joshua 15:11
The preceding verse describes the course of the boundary toward Baal-shemesh, which continues in verse 11
Jabneel is also mentioned in the boundary description of Naphtali, although this is a different city with the same name
Ekron is mentioned in connection with the ark of the covenant when it was sent back to Israel
Ekron is mentioned as one of the cities Judah took possession of during the conquest
